projects.title: Restrolover
projects.subtitle: A modern hospitality experience powered by design and technology.
projects.problem: Admins uploading high-resolution food photography (3MB - 10MB) directly from their phones or desktop computers filled up the browser’s strict 5MB localStorage limit instantly, crashing the state updates and leaving saving modals frozen.
projects.solution: Integrated a canvas utility that automatically resizes and compresses any uploaded image file down to ~30KB - 50KB at 75% quality before it ever hits state.

projects.title: Choyo An Hourly Room Booking System
projects.subtitle: A full-stack PHP & MySQL application for hourly room reservations with a powerful admin management dashboard.
projects.problem: Many small hotels, hostels, and meeting spaces rely on manual booking methods, making it difficult to track room availability, prevent double bookings, and manage reservations efficiently. The objective was to build a centralized system that enables users to book rooms on an hourly basis while providing administrators with complete control over rooms and reservations.
projects.solution: Developed a full-stack Room Booking System using PHP and MySQL with an intuitive booking workflow. The application allows users to browse available rooms, select booking hours, submit reservations, and receive booking confirmation. A dedicated admin panel enables administrators to manage rooms, bookings, pricing, and customer information from a single dashboard.
projects.architecture:
Frontend: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript

Backend: PHP

Database: MySQL

The application follows a client-server architecture where PHP handles business logic and MySQL stores booking, room, and customer data. CRUD operations are implemented for room management and reservation handling.
projects.impact:
• Simplified room reservation process
• Reduced manual booking management
• Prevented booking conflicts through availability checks
• Responsive interface for desktop and mobile devices
• Centralized admin dashboard for efficient management
projects.performance: PHP MySQL Responsive UI  Admin Dashboard  Booking Management

projects.problem: The rapid growth of social media platforms has increased the presence of fake and spam accounts, making it difficult to identify authentic users manually. Detecting suspicious accounts requires analyzing complex user behavior patterns such as followers, following, engagement, and activity metrics.
projects.solution:
Developed a machine learning-based classification system to identify fake and genuine Instagram accounts.
Performed data preprocessing, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis to discover behavioral patterns.
Built a Random Forest Classifier for account classification.
Analyzed key indicators such as followers, following ratio, engagement metrics, and activity patterns.

Today, I specialize in creating modern digital experiences using technologies like React, Next.js, Node.js, AI/ML workflows, and data-driven systems — combining technical depth with creative problem-solving.
